description: If one finite word extends another, its path cone is contained in the cone of the shorter word.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.cone_antitone (T : Set (List ℕ)) {s t : List ℕ} (h : s <+: t) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.cone T t ⊆ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.cone T s
